statement.summary: Lemma 3.5 is frozen as `multiPrimeJoinStatement`: for every family Jf : ℕ → Set of subgroups with Jf p ⊆ 𝓛_p for each prime p ∣ n, |⟨⋃_{p∣n} ⋃_{C∈Jf p} C⟩| = ∏_{p∣n} p^{rk_p(Jf p)}. The disjoint union ⨆ is rendered as a plain union of the family; that nothing is lost (the 𝓛_p for distinct p are disjoint) is recorded as the separate frozen Prop `orderPCycDisjointStatement`.

lean_decls.role: statement (disjointness justification, not a paper claim)

deltas: J = ⨆_{p∣n} J_p is the plain union ⋃_{p∈primeFactors n} Jf p of a family `Jf : ℕ → Set (AddSubgroup (Lat n d))`; the 𝓛_p for distinct primes are disjoint (`orderPCycDisjointStatement`), so the union is automatically disjoint and every J ⊆ 𝓛 arises with J_p = J ∩ 𝓛_p. Values of Jf at non-prime-divisors are ignored.
'p ∣ n' ranges over `n.primeFactors` (the prime divisors of n); empty J_p are allowed (factor p^0 = 1).
⟨⋃J⟩ = `AddSubgroup.closure` of the union of the carriers; |·| = `Nat.card`.
rk J_p = `rk n d p (Jf p)`: the rank of Lemma 3.3, computed in 𝔽_p^d for the prime p of the factor (the paper leaves the dependence on p implicit).
Standing hypotheses n ≥ 2, d ≥ 1; no alphabet appears.
